verdict.rationale: The product's own CLI clearly starts the server: `local-ai run <model>` and `docker run -p 8080:8080 ... localai/localai`, with server flags such as --preload-models and --external-grpc-backends, after which the API is reachable at localhost:8080. Nothing in the evidence documents a stop, shutdown or lifecycle command, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented CLI stop/shutdown or service-management commands, an explicit statement that `local-ai run` launches the API server, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
The --external-grpc-backends parameter in the CLI can be used either to specify a local backend (a file) or a remote URL.
You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
